BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeowner's insurance; and adding a new sectionto chapter 48.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer licensed to write homeowner's insurance in this stateshall not deny an application for a homeowner's insurance policy, orcancel, refuse to renew, or modify an existing homeowner's insurancepolicy for the principal reason that the applicant or insured is afoster parent licensed under chapter 74.15 RCW.
